name: Lavi Olfa Ibn Almaz
original_name: ラビ・オルファ・イブン・アルマース
source:
Wild Prince

15th Prince of Kajura. Has many wives. He's wild, free, and fearless. Loves women. But what's his huge, hidden secret?
